PR #2690 delta: already committed and pushed by an antigravity session at 00:48 (b5e21f5503 = PR head). It drops '; STORY-1699' from docs/cli/03-work-autonomy.md:282 and adds the trace comment.
Lease 01a142fc NOT ended: 'aida session end 01a142fc --yes --skip-ci' was refused by this job's permission classifier.

STORY-1699 digest work is BLOCKED. This job's sandbox makes the git database (/home/joe/ai/aida/.git) and every sibling worktree read-only ('git hash-object -w' fails with "Read-only file system"), so I cannot commit the WIP in aida-story-1699, rebase it, or push. Nothing was changed.

WIP review (aida-story-1699, base 463b81d027):
- All 10 modified files and the new cargo_activity.rs, fleet_digest.rs and fleet_lanes.rs (1345 lines) are on-scope for STORY-1699 AC1-7. None is unrelated.
- No tests yet: fixture lanes per state, a blocked relay, a stale PR and fan-out attribution are all still TODO.
- Bug: cli.rs inserts FleetCommand between NoHumanCommand's doc comment and its #[derive], so that doc comment is now attached to FleetCommand.
- Not yet scheduled: a 'fleet digest --fail-on-findings' command_table entry plus a CronJobFailed route job. Place them away from #2690's relay-stall hunks to avoid a conflict.
- fleet_lanes.rs is pub(crate). classify_lanes() is the entry point STORY-1700 will use.

Resuming needs a seat with git write access.
subject: PR #2690 delta pushed (b5e21f5503); STORY-1699 digest blocked by sandbox
